findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess calls
 * @description Find calls to subprocess and os.system to identify potential command injection risks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-calls
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to subprocess or os execution function."
findings.hypothesis: Potential command injection if arguments are user-controlled.

message.text: Call to subprocess or os execution function.
Call to subprocess or os execution function.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection from Environment
 * @description Command injection from environment variables
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-env
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CommandInjectionEnvConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getAValueReachableFromSource() or
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("getenv").getACall()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SystemCommandExecution ce).getCommand()
  }
}

module CommandInjectionEnvFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionEnvConfig>;
import CommandInjectionEnvFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionEnvFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionEnvFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionEnvFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "environment variable"

/**
 * @name Unsafe Tarfile Extraction
 * @description Extracting tar archives without validating paths can cause path traversal.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-tarfile-extraction
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("TarFile").getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  or
   call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("open").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential unsafe tarfile extraction."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe extraction of tar files allowing path traversal.
